newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tristate 1996 net down 47 percent.
newsitem.headline: Tristate 1996 net down 47 percent.

text.p: NOTE - Tristate is a garment manufacturer.
The exceptional loss in the current year represents a severance payment of approximately HK$7 million from the lay off of about 1,100 employees of one of the group's factories in the Philippines.

Under discontinued operations, G.F.I. Holding Co, Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States engaged in garment and general trading, was closed down in December 1995 due to escalating operating costs in the United States. The operating results of GFI were shown as discontinued operations in the consolidated profit and loss account. The profit in the current year represents a write-back of the over-provision for expenditures in connection with the closure.
Total dividend for year is 10 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of 10 cents) vs 45 cents.
